blocks.text: «Qayerda?» savoliga o'zbekchada ko'pincha bitta `-da` qo'shimchasi bilan javob beramiz: xona**da**, bekat**da**, devor**da**, Toshkent**da**. Kerak bo'lsa ko'makchi qo'shamiz: quti **ichida**, stol **ustida**. Ingliz tilida esa joyga qanday «qarayotganimizga» qarab uchta predlogdan biri tanlanadi: joy — **idish** (ichida) bo'lsa **in**, **nuqta** bo'lsa **at**, **sirt** (yuza) bo'lsa **on**. Predlog, albatta, otdan **oldin** keladi: **in** the room — xona**da**.

**in** biror narsa chegaralangan joy **ichida** ekanini bildiradi. Bu xona, quti, sumka, mashina bo'lishi mumkin: **in** the bathroom, **in** my pocket, **in** a taxi. Suv, osmon, bog', park, o'rmon ham «ichiga» kiriladigan joy: **in** the sea, **in** the sky, **in** the garden, **in** the park. Shahar, qishloq, mamlakat ham chegarasi bor hudud: **in** Bukhara, **in** a village, **in** England. Bunda tashqi ko'rinishi muhim emas — o'sha hudud **ichida** ekanimiz muhim.

items.text: The ducks are swimming **in** the pond.
My cousin works **in** a hotel **in** Oxford.

blocks.text: **at** joyni **nuqta** sifatida ko'rsatadi: biz u yerda turibmiz, kutyapmiz, uchrashyapmiz — ichida yoki ustida ekanimiz muhim emas. **at** the bus stop, **at** the door, **at** the window, **at** the traffic lights, **at** reception, **at** the checkout. Biror narsaning chekka nuqtalari ham **at** bilan: **at** the top, **at** the bottom, **at** the end, **at** the back, **at** the front. O'zbekchada bunga ko'pincha «oldida», «oxirida», «tepasida» kabi ko'makchilar mos keladi.

items.text: Somebody is waiting for you **at** the gate.
Sign your name **at** the bottom of the form.

blocks.text: **on** narsa biror **yuzaga tegib turganini** bildiradi: **on** the table, **on** the floor, **on** a shelf, **on** a plate. Muhimi: devor, eshik, shift ham yuza, shuning uchun rasm **on** the wall, yozuv **on** the door, chiroq **on** the ceiling. O'zbekchada «devor ustida» demaymiz — «devor**da**», «devor**ga** osilgan», lekin inglizchada baribir **on**. Sahifa, ekran, xarita, menyu ham yuza: **on** page 7, **on** the screen, **on** the map. Velosiped, ot, mototsikl ustida o'tirish ham **on**: **on** a bike, **on** a horse.

items.text: There's a clock **on** the wall above the door.
Put the plates **on** the table, please.

blocks.text: Ba'zan bir joyning o'zi bilan ikki xil predlog ishlatiladi va ma'no o'zgaradi. Predlog «joyning qaysi qismida ekanimiz»ni aniq aytadi, o'zbekchada esa bu farq ko'pincha ko'makchi bilan ifodalanadi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «in the table» → **on the table**; «The picture is in the wall.» → **on the wall**; «on the room» → **in the room**; «I live at Tashkent.» → **in Tashkent** (shahar — in); «I'm waiting on the bus stop.» → **at the bus stop**; «in page 5» → **on page 5**; «in the bike» → **on the bike**. Diqqat: «He's sitting **on** the table» — stolning ustiga chiqib o'tiribdi; ovqatlanayotgan bo'lsa — **at** the table.

Uch rasmni tasavvur qiling: **quti** (ichiga kirish mumkin — **in**), **xaritadagi nuqta** yoki uchrashuv joyi (**at**), **stol yuzasi** (ustiga qo'yish yoki osish mumkin — **on**). Shubha bo'lsa, o'zingizdan so'rang: «Ichidami? Nuqtadami? Yuzasidami?»

Bog'lanish: turg'un iboralar (at home, in bed, on the train, at the airport) — 107-dars; harakat va yo'nalish (go **to**, arrive **in / at**) — 108-dars; under, behind, next to, opposite — 109-dars; vaqt predloglari at / on / in — 103-dars.

**in** the garden, **in** the park, **in** the sea

examples.title: **in**: inside a room, a box, a bag
examples.description: Chegarasi bor joy ichida — **in**: in the kitchen, in a box, in my bag, in the car, in the water. O'zbekchada «-da» yoki «ichida».

sentences.text: The children are playing **in** their room.
sentences.translation: Bolalar o'z xonalari**da** o'ynayapti.

sentences.text: Is there any milk **in** the fridge?
sentences.translation: Muzlatkich**da** sut bormi?

sentences.text: I found my keys **in** my coat pocket.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni palto cho'ntagim**dan** topdim.

sentences.text: Aziz is waiting for you **in** the car.
sentences.translation: Aziz sizni mashina**da** kutyapti.

sentences.text: My grandmother keeps old photos **in** a wooden box.
sentences.translation: Buvim eski suratlarni yog'och quti **ichida** saqlaydi.

sentences.text: Don't swim **in** the river — the water is very cold.
sentences.translation: Daryo**da** cho'milmang — suv juda sovuq.

sentences.text: What's **in** that big bag? — Just some clothes.
sentences.translation: Anavi katta sumka**da** nima bor? — Shunchaki kiyimlar.

sentences.text: We sat **in** the garden and drank tea until sunset.
sentences.translation: Bog'**da** o'tirib, quyosh botguncha choy ichdik.

sentences.text: There were dark clouds **in** the sky, so we took our umbrellas.
sentences.translation: Osmon**da** qora bulutlar bor edi, shuning uchun soyabonlarimizni oldik.

sentences.text: It's warm **in** the office, but outside it's freezing.
sentences.translation: Ofis **ichi** iliq, tashqarida esa qahraton sovuq.

examples.title: **in** a village, **in** a country, **in** the park
examples.description: Shahar, qishloq, mamlakat, park, o'rmon — chegarasi bor hudud, shuning uchun **in**: in Samarkand, in England, in the park, in the city centre.

sentences.text: My aunt lives **in** a small village near Namangan.
sentences.translation: Xolam Namangan yaqinidagi kichik qishloq**da** yashaydi.

sentences.text: Emma was born **in** Manchester, but she grew up **in** Scotland.
sentences.translation: Emma Manchester**da** tug'ilgan, lekin Shotlandiya**da** ulg'aygan.

sentences.text: There are lots of old buildings **in** the centre of Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxoro markazi**da** ko'plab qadimiy binolar bor.

sentences.text: Let's have a picnic **in** the park on Sunday.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni park**da** piknik qilaylik.

sentences.text: How many people live **in** Uzbekistan? — Over thirty-seven million.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston**da** qancha odam yashaydi? — O'ttiz yetti milliondan ortiq.

sentences.text: We got lost **in** the forest and walked for hours.
sentences.translation: O'rmon**da** adashib qolib, soatlab yurdik.

sentences.text: Is your flat **in** the city centre? — No, it's **in** a quiet area near the river.
sentences.translation: Kvartirangiz shahar markazi**da**mi? — Yo'q, daryo yaqinidagi tinch mavze**da**.

sentences.text: Tom has worked **in** many countries, but he likes Japan best.
sentences.translation: Tom ko'p mamlakatlar**da** ishlagan, lekin Yaponiya unga hammasidan ko'proq yoqadi.

sentences.text: **In** Tashkent the summer is hot, but **in** London it's mild and rainy.
sentences.translation: Toshkent**da** yoz issiq bo'ladi, London**da** esa iliq va yomg'irli.

sentences.text: Dilnoza spent her childhood **in** the mountains, so she loves fresh air.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning bolaligi tog'lar**da** o'tgan, shuning uchun u toza havoni yaxshi ko'radi.

examples.title: **at**: at the bus stop, at the door
examples.description: Nuqta — kimdir turgan, kutadigan, uchrashadigan joy: at the bus stop, at the door, at the window, at the traffic lights. Ichkari yoki tashqari muhim emas.

sentences.text: I'll wait for you **at** the bus stop.
sentences.translation: Sizni avtobus bekati**da** kutaman.

sentences.text: Someone is **at** the door — can you open it?
sentences.translation: Eshik **oldida** kimdir turibdi — ochib yuborasizmi?

sentences.text: Turn left **at** the traffic lights.
sentences.translation: Svetofor**da** chapga buriling.

sentences.text: Grandma likes to sit **at** the window and watch the street.
sentences.translation: Buvim deraza **oldida** o'tirib, ko'chani tomosha qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Please leave your key **at** reception when you go out.
sentences.translation: Tashqariga chiqqaningizda kalitingizni qabul bo'limi**da** qoldiring, iltimos.

sentences.text: Let's meet **at** the main entrance of the museum.
sentences.translation: Muzeyning asosiy kirish eshigi **oldida** uchrashaylik.

sentences.text: There was a long queue **at** the checkout, so I left.
sentences.translation: Kassa**da** uzun navbat bor edi, shuning uchun chiqib ketdim.

sentences.text: Why is that man standing **at** the gate? — He's the new security guard.
sentences.translation: Anavi odam nega darvoza **oldida** turibdi? — U yangi qorovul.

sentences.text: The taxi stopped **at** the crossroads, and Bekzod got out.
sentences.translation: Taksi chorraha**da** to'xtadi va Bekzod tushdi.

sentences.text: Sarah was standing **at** the counter, paying for her coffee, when her phone rang.
sentences.translation: Sara peshtaxta **oldida** qahvasi uchun pul to'layotganda telefoni jiringladi.

examples.title: **at** the top, **at** the bottom, **at** the end
examples.description: Biror narsaning chekka nuqtasi — **at**: at the top of the page, at the bottom of the stairs, at the end of the street, at the back of the room.

sentences.text: Please write your full name **at** the top of the first page.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, to'liq ismingizni birinchi sahifaning **yuqori qismiga** yozing.

sentences.text: The bathroom is **at** the end of the corridor.
sentences.translation: Hammom yo'lakning **oxirida**.

sentences.text: Our car is parked **at** the bottom of the hill.
sentences.translation: Mashinamiz tepalik **etagida** turibdi.

sentences.text: There's a small shop **at** the corner of our street.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamiz **muyulishida** kichik do'kon bor.

sentences.text: Tall students should sit **at** the back of the class.
sentences.translation: Bo'yi baland o'quvchilar sinfning **orqa tomonida** o'tirishi kerak.

sentences.text: Who's the boy **at** the front of the queue?
sentences.translation: Navbatning **boshida** turgan bola kim?

sentences.text: The answers are **at** the back of the book.
sentences.translation: Javoblar kitobning **oxirida**.

sentences.text: **At** the top of the mountain it was cold and windy.
sentences.translation: Tog' **cho'qqisida** sovuq va shamolli edi.

sentences.text: My flat is **at** the end of a long street, so it's very quiet.
sentences.translation: Kvartiram uzun ko'chaning **oxirida**, shuning uchun juda jim.

sentences.text: Madina waited **at** the bottom of the stairs while her brother went up for the bags.
sentences.translation: Akasi sumkalarni olgani yuqoriga chiqqanda Madina zinapoyaning **pastida** kutib turdi.

examples.title: **on**: on the table, on the wall, on the floor
examples.description: Sirt ustida — **on**: on the table, on the floor, on a shelf. Devor, eshik, shift ham yuza: on the wall, on the door, on the ceiling. O'zbekchada «ustida», «-da» yoki «-ga».

sentences.text: Your glasses are **on** the kitchen table.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagingiz oshxonadagi stol **ustida**.

sentences.text: There's a beautiful carpet **on** the floor.
sentences.translation: Pol**da** chiroyli gilam to'shalgan.

sentences.text: Look at the spider **on** the ceiling!
sentences.translation: Shift**dagi** o'rgimchakka qarang!

sentences.text: We hung a map of the world **on** the wall.
sentences.translation: Devor**ga** dunyo xaritasini osdik.

sentences.text: Can you put the books back **on** the shelf, please?
sentences.translation: Kitoblarni javon**ga** qaytarib qo'yasizmi?

sentences.text: Someone has written a message **on** the classroom door.
sentences.translation: Kimdir sinf eshigi**ga** xabar yozib qo'yibdi.

sentences.text: The cat is sleeping **on** the sofa again.
sentences.translation: Mushuk yana divan **ustida** uxlayapti.

sentences.text: Don't put your wet umbrella **on** the bed!
sentences.translation: Ho'l soyaboningizni karavot **ustiga** qo'ymang!

sentences.text: James sat **on** the floor because all the chairs were taken.
sentences.translation: Barcha stullar band bo'lgani uchun Jeyms pol**da** o'tirdi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza put a bowl of fruit **on** the table and invited everyone to sit down.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza stol **ustiga** bir tovoq meva qo'yib, hammani o'tirishga taklif qildi.

examples.title: **on** page 5, **on** the screen, **on** a bike
examples.description: Sahifa, ekran, xarita, menyu, muqova ham yuza: on page 10, on the screen, on the map. Velosiped, ot, tuya ustida — ham **on**.

sentences.text: The exercise is **on** page 24.
sentences.translation: Mashq 24-sahifa**da**.

sentences.text: Can you find Khiva **on** this map?
sentences.translation: Bu xarita**da** Xivani topa olasizmi?

sentences.text: What's **on** the menu today?
sentences.translation: Bugun menyu**da** nima bor?

sentences.text: I saw your photo **on** Emma's phone.
sentences.translation: Suratingizni Emmaning telefoni**da** ko'rdim.

sentences.text: There was a strange message **on** the screen, so I switched off the computer.
sentences.translation: Ekran**da** g'alati xabar chiqdi, shuning uchun kompyuterni o'chirdim.

sentences.text: Bekzod goes to school **on** his bike every day.
sentences.translation: Bekzod har kuni maktabga velosiped**da** boradi.

sentences.text: The children rode **on** a camel in the desert near Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bolalar Buxoro yaqinidagi cho'lda tuya**ga minib** sayr qilishdi.

sentences.text: We had breakfast **on** the balcony because it was sunny.
sentences.translation: Havo quyoshli bo'lgani uchun balkon**da** nonushta qildik.

sentences.text: Look — there's a photo of the Registan **on** the cover of this magazine!
sentences.translation: Qarang, bu jurnal muqovasi**da** Registon surati bor!

sentences.text: Tom wrote his phone number **on** a piece of paper and gave it to me.
sentences.translation: Tom telefon raqamini bir varaq qog'oz**ga** yozib, menga berdi.

examples.title: **in**, **at** or **on**? One place, different meaning
examples.description: Bir joy — har xil predlog: **at** the table (atrofida) / **on** the table (ustida); **at** the door / **on** the door; **in** the water / **on** the water; **in** the corner / **at** the corner.

sentences.text: The family is sitting **at** the table, having dinner.
sentences.translation: Oila stol **atrofida** o'tirib, kechki ovqat qilyapti.

sentences.text: The cat is sitting **on** the table — get it off!
sentences.translation: Mushuk stol **ustida** o'tiribdi — tushiring uni!

sentences.text: A man is waiting **at** the door — he wants to speak to you.
sentences.translation: Eshik **oldida** bir kishi kutyapti — u siz bilan gaplashmoqchi.

sentences.text: There's a "No smoking" sign **on** the door.
sentences.translation: Eshik**da** «Chekish mumkin emas» degan yozuv bor.

sentences.text: Some children are swimming **in** the lake.
sentences.translation: Ko'l**da** bir necha bola suzyapti.

sentences.text: A few small boats are floating **on** the water.
sentences.translation: Suv **ustida** bir nechta kichik qayiq suzib yuribdi.

sentences.text: The TV is **in** the corner of the living room.
sentences.translation: Televizor mehmonxonaning **burchagida**.

sentences.text: There's a pharmacy **at** the corner of the street.
sentences.translation: Ko'cha **muyulishida** dorixona bor.

sentences.text: Birds are singing **in** the tree outside my window.
sentences.translation: Derazam oldidagi daraxt**da** qushlar sayrayapti.

sentences.text: There are lots of red apples **on** that tree — let's pick some!
sentences.translation: Anavi daraxt**da** qizil olmalar ko'p — bir nechtasini uzaylik!

examples.title: Where's my ...? — **In** / **At** / **On** ...
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: «Where ...?» savollariga javob — in, at yoki on. O'zbekchada deyarli hammasi «-da».

sentences.text: Where's my phone? — **On** the sofa, I think.
sentences.translation: Telefonim qayerda? — Divan **ustida**, shekilli.

sentences.text: Where are the children? — **In** the garden with their grandfather.
sentences.translation: Bolalar qayerda? — Bobolari bilan bog'**da**.

sentences.text: Where did you leave the car? — **At** the end of the road.
sentences.translation: Mashinani qayerda qoldirdingiz? — Yo'lning **oxirida**.

sentences.text: Is Aziz still waiting **at** the bus stop? — Yes, the bus is late.
sentences.translation: Aziz hali ham bekat**da** kutyaptimi? — Ha, avtobus kechikyapti.

sentences.text: Have you seen my glasses? — Yes, they're **on** your head!
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagimni ko'rdingizmi? — Ha, boshingiz**da**-ku!

sentences.text: Is there any bread **in** the cupboard? — No, but there's some **on** the table.
sentences.translation: Shkaf**da** non bormi? — Yo'q, lekin stol **ustida** bor.

sentences.text: Do you live **in** the centre of Oxford? — No, **in** a village outside the city.
sentences.translation: Oksford markazi**da** yashaysizmi? — Yo'q, shahar tashqarisidagi qishloq**da**.

sentences.text: Which picture do you mean? — The one **on** the wall **at** the top of the stairs.
sentences.translation: Qaysi rasmni nazarda tutyapsiz? — Zinapoya **tepasidagi** devor**dagi** rasmni.

sentences.text: Excuse me, are the toilets **at** the back of the restaurant? — Yes, near the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hojatxona restoranning **orqa tomonida**mi? — Ha, oshxona yaqinida.

sentences.text: Madina, your keys aren't **in** your bag — they're still **in** the door!
sentences.translation: Madina, kalitlaring sumkang**da** emas — hali ham eshik**da** qolib ketibdi!
